body: Vocal Remover using Deep Neural Networks
plain_description: Extract clean instrumental tracks from any song using AI — no studio required. Remove vocals from audio files for karaoke, video production, or music analysis with a single command. The tool runs entirely on your own machine, keeping your audio private and secure.
technical_description: vocal-remover separates mixed audio into instrumental and vocal tracks using deep neural networks implemented in PyTorch. The tool uses a deep U-Net convolutional architecture for audio source separation. It runs inference on CPU or NVIDIA GPU, with optional test-time augmentation and a post-processing mask for improved separation quality. The package includes a training pipeline for users to train custom models on their own instrument/mixture datasets. The tool is distributed as a Python CLI application with dependencies managed through pip.
title: Vocal Remover
